note: Campground in mature spruce near the Berland River just south of Hwy 40, about 70 km north-west of Hinton, run by the Fox Creek Development Association for West Fraser; a few sites back onto the river. The hand-pump water is not safe to drink; bring water. Firewood for sale. Horses are not allowed in the campground; a user-maintained equestrian staging area for the Willmore Wilderness is down the road. --Claude
